answer: Silicon-escrow admission: a key earns weight only while one attested vertex keeps an unbroken signal for it and locks lotus behind that key. One vertex backs one live key; a forked, late or copied signal burns the lotus. Each added head under one buyer must bring a fresh vertex from a separate supply cluster and double the escrow: head five locks sixteen lotus, n heads lock 2^n−1 lotus and need n unshared hardware histories, not slices of rented hosts.
